_why: Rules: no animals or animal words, no 'rot'. Display text only; ids stay. Applied to the Godot data and to be applied to the web build.

lines.No birds. There have never been birds he: Nothing sings over the Moor. Nothing ever has. The wind only practises.
lines.The Sighing Lantern hums through its cra: The Sighing Lantern hums through its cracked bell. The ash pools beneath it, listening.
lines.Cinders lift when you pass and follow a: Cinders lift when you pass and follow a little way, like mourners who lost the coffin.
lines.A loom rotting on its frame, the last sh: A loom sagging on its frame, the last shroud half-woven. The shuttle is still warm.
lines.A chapel the wolves took. They left the: A chapel the hungry took. They left the pews and ate the rest.
lines.A pew split by a body thrown hard. The w: A pew split by a body thrown hard. The hungry were not the first to fight here.
lines.Vinegar and tallow and rot. The hospice: Vinegar and tallow and old wounds. The hospice still smells of mercy attempted.
lines.Salt heaped to the rafters. It kept the: Salt heaped to the rafters. It kept the goods from spoiling. Mostly.
lines.Something drinks the light before it rea: Something drinks the light before it reaches the road.
lines.Keep the lantern on your left. The moths: Keep the lantern on your left. The dead... prefer the right.
lines.The moths remember you. Do not ask what: The ash remembers you. Do not ask what it remembers.
